build.buildCommand: rm -rf node_modules/.prisma node_modules/@prisma && npm install && npx prisma generate && node -e "console.log(require('@prisma/client').PrismaClient.toString().includes('imageUrl') ? 'OK' : 'STALE')"

deploy.startCommand: npx prisma db push --skip-generate && node dist/seed.js && node dist/index.js
